refs.description: Object refs from one current DOCX observation, returned in this order. Use row, cell, or paragraph refs; table-rooted reads are rejected.

revision.description: Optional expected revision id from the observation receipt; a changed document fails as stale.

kinds.description: Object kinds required by the next operation. Include paragraph for table content boundaries. Request run or text only when ref identifies a cell or paragraph, never a whole table.

output.description: Absolute path for a new JSON artifact containing the selected native object and only the requested descendant kinds.
